## Overview

Mini-apps API and dApp framework — third-party apps running inside the Usernode mobile app, using the wallet and identity primitives. Idea and Demo phases closed with the merge of #352 ("further dApp improvements"). No active work; the initiative is parked until Core Testnet capacity opens up.
